data.title: Anthropic IPO Could Be Bitcoin's Next Catalyst: Arthur Hayes Turns 'Mini-Bulled Up' Ahead Of Nasdaq Listing
data.description: Earlier this month, Hayes said Anthropic IPO investors would face 83% dilution by June 2027, calling it "almost mathematically impossible" for the stock to gain before then.
